maddeler.e:
أتفلسف (form IIq)
# أَتَفَلْسَفُ (ʔatafalsafu) /ʔa.ta.fal.sa.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
# أَتَفَلْسَفَ (ʔatafalsafa) /ʔa.ta.fal.sa.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
# أَتَفَلْسَفْ (ʔatafalsaf) /ʔa.ta.fal.saf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
